cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite
make clean >/dev/null 2>&1; make >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "release built"
mkdir -p out_large
echo "=== timing probe: spectral-gaps Q=243 L=48 (heaviest) ==="
